searchText: somewhat outside the scope of the networking/consensus/execution world. Are there any experimental solidity compilers for testing on the devnet (precompile calling - what is the address for the blob commitment verification?)? are blob hashes available via `tx.blobHash` or similar? ``` pragma solidity >=0.7.0 <0.9.0; contract BlobCaller { bool _ok; bytes out; fallback (bytes calldata _input) external returns (bytes memory _output) { address precompile = address(0x0A); (bool ok, bytes memory output) = precompile.call{gas: 50000}(_input); _output = output; // Store return values to trigger sstore _ok = ok; out = output; } } ``` This is the code I'm using in my tx-fuzz tester nice - and thank you
